name: Quarterly Planning: The Launch Plan

long_description:
Overview

Step away from the day-to-day and build a clear, practical plan for the next quarter.

2027: Make It Your Best Business Year Yet!


The Launch Plan – Plan for Growth, Profit & Freedom

Are you busy running your business but not necessarily getting where you want to go?

It's easy to get caught up in the day-to-day. You're working hard, making decisions and keeping everything moving, but when was the last time you stopped to look at whether your business is actually taking you where you want to be?

The Launch Plan is a practical, interactive business planning workshop designed to help you step away from the daily demands of running your business and get clear on what needs to change.

We'll start by looking back at 2026, then build a picture of what you want your business and life to look like by December 2027.

From there, we'll identify the gaps between where you are now and where you want to be, so you can focus on the things that will make the biggest difference.

What we'll work through
Review 2026: What's worked, what hasn't and what have you learned?
Create your 2027 vision: What do you want your business and life to look like by the end of next year?
Identify your business gaps: What's currently stopping you from getting there?
Decide what needs attention: Which gaps are having the biggest impact on your profit, growth or freedom?
Choose your priorities: What are the three most important things to focus on?
Build your 90-day plan: Turn those priorities into practical actions for January–March 2027.
What you'll walk away with

A clearer picture of where your business is today, a vision for where you want to take it and a practical 90-day action plan to help you get there.

This isn't a day of sitting and listening. You'll be working on your own business, sharing ideas and making decisions about what really matters.

Event details

Monday 7 December 2026
9:00 am – 3:30 pm
Paraparaumu Beach Golf Club

Investment: $149 + GST ($171.35 including GST)

Complimentary attendance for existing coaching clients and invited guests.

Don't just hope 2027 will be a better year. Plan for it!

Wairarapa Heritage Homesteads and Church Tour-Llandaff Country Residence
Masterton, Wellington Region-Event Brite
name: Wairarapa Heritage Homesteads and Church Tour
venue:
Llandaff Country Residence
Masterton, Wellington Region
long_description:
Overview

Visit Llandaff, Brancepeth and the Masterton Greek Orthodox Church as part of the Wellington Heritage Festival.

Robin Dunlop and Ed Beetham are offering their support for this year’s Wellington Heritage Festival by arranging a tour of two significant heritage homesteads in the Masterton area, Llandaff and Brancepeth, and a visit to the Greek Orthodox Church.

The tour starts at Llandaff Country Homestead, home of Robin and Elizabeth Dunlop at 10am with tea and coffee and a tour of the homestead and grounds and at 12 noon the tour will move to the Greek Orthodox Church in Masterton for a half hour tour.

The tour will then move to the historic homestead and outbuildings at Brancepeth, arriving at 2pm for a welcome by Ed Beetham, a self guided tour and afternoon tea.

Please note: bring own lunch or buy prior to Brancepeth tour.

For further contact:

Phone Robin Dunlop, mob 021 359 562 or email robin@llandaff.co.nz.
